business_summary: Asahi Group Holdings, Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of beer, alcohol and non-alcohol beverages, and food products in Japan, Europe, Oceania, and Southeast Asia. The company offers alcoholic beverage products, including beers, non-alcohol beer, new genre, wines, shochu, whiskey and spirits, ready-to-drink beverages, and happoshu products. It also provides non-alcoholic beverage products beverages, such as carbonated drinks, coffee, tea, lactic acid bacteria drinks, and mineral water. It offers its products primarily under the Asahi Super Dry, Peroni Nastro Azzurro, Kozel, Pilsner Urquell, Grolsch, Great Northern, Victoria Bitter, Carlton Draught, Balter, Tyskie, Ursus, Radegast, Dreher, London Pride, Asahi Nama Beer, Captain Jack, Dry Zero, Great Northern Zero, Asahi Zero, Asahi Zeitaku Shibori, Mirai no Lemon Sour, Hard Rated, Nikka, Vodka Cruiser, Mitsuya, Wilkinson, Calpis, Wonda, Asahi Jurokucha, Asahi Oishiimizu, Solo, Cool Ridge, Allpress, Goodday, Mintia, Ippon Manzoku Bar, Dear-Natura, Amano Foods, and Wakodo. The company was formerly known as Asahi Breweries, Ltd. and changed its name to Asahi Group Holdings, Ltd. in July 2011. Asahi Group Holdings, Ltd. was founded in 1889 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Asahi Group Holdings, Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 일본, 유럽, 오세아니아 및 동남아시아에서 맥주, 주류 및 무알코올 음료, 식품의 제조 및 판매에 종사하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 맥주, 무알코올 맥주, 새로운 장르, 와인, 소주, 위스키 및 증류주, 즉석 음료, 핫포슈 제품을 포함한 알코올 음료 제품을 제공합니다. 또한 탄산음료, 커피, 차, 유산균 음료, 생수 등의 무알콜 음료 제품 음료도 제공합니다. 주로 Asahi Super Dry, Peroni Nastro Azzurro, Kozel, Pilsner Urquell, Grolsch, Great Northern, Victoria Bitter, Carlton Draught, Balter, Tyskie, Ursus, Radegast, Dreher, London Pride, Asahi Nama Beer, Captain Jack, Dry Zero, Great Northern Zero, Asahi Zero, Asahi Zeitaku Shibori, Mirai no Lemon Sour, Hard Rated, Nikka, Vodka Cruiser, Mitsuya, Wilkinson, Calpis, Wonda, Asahi Jurokucha, Asahi Oishiimizu, Solo, Cool Ridge, Allpress, Goodday, Mintia, Ippon Manzoku Bar, Dear-Natura, Amano Foods 및 Wakodo. 이 회사는 이전에는 Asahi Breweries, Ltd.로 알려졌으나 2011년 7월에 Asahi Group Holdings, Ltd.로 사명을 변경했습니다.
